name: D92 physical support metric GGN1 + LocalRidge joint support diagnostic
description: One derived rank-aware U-coordinate candidate, fixed 4 rows/160 physical parents and 1800 paths, paired A/B/C; no parameter grid
authorization: Existing user LocalRidge-priority joint target-support SFT/frozen summaries/subagent authorization; root sole launch owner

data.dataset: Support slices only from the two existing VALIDATED_ONCE capsules
data.representation: Existing immutable support-only z_id/fft/t_emb/f_emb/pa_local; same single received observation
data.split_id: Explicit selected 40 support splits per cohort; complete original producer matrix retained
data.validation_ref: Existing cohort capsule manifests; no data rebuild or revalidation
data.support_query_ref: Only registered support_indices/support_labels are consumed; query excluded
data.reuse_policy: VALIDATED_ONCE; runtime artifact identity/binding checks only, no new data validation

checkpoint.initialization: Exact source-only scratch final200 model; eval and frozen; no changed buffers or weights
checkpoint.selection_rule: Two smallest fixed source model seeds, final200, selected from metadata before results
checkpoint.inheritance_policy: Only original source-only model; no historical adapted head/cache state
checkpoint.current_auxiliary_training: Only current U rank coordinates (r<=5) trained from legal support; exact stored ground-Q basis construction, complete Ridge/gate JVP, frozen source encoder/centers; C inherits only actual same-path B, no other-method adapter
checkpoint.feature_cache_producer_role: support-only raw frozen features; no learned state

permissions.truth_use: Legal inner-held support labels supervise adapter; outer-held labels only score frozen predictions; no query

code.commit_note: Preparation parent; actual immutable pushed runtime OID recorded after unique launch

execution.stop_rule: Technical failure fails only its lane; healthy lanes finish. No automatic retry, no stopping for weak support diagnostics.
execution.gpu_policy: CPU2 / BLAS2 / CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; fixed support caches; healthy query unchanged
execution.ground_transfer_accounting: Conservative already_deployed=false, full two-file component payload counted; native wire/model initial transfer N/A
execution.fresh_independent_validation: Deferred by explicit user request; diagnostic is not query performance

support_analysis.scope: Complete immutable saved-state support diagnostic; no query generalization or promotion

support_analysis_scalar_r02.scope: Read-only complete saved-state analysis; sole internal NumPy/Python scalar boundary correction, not method/tolerance/fit change

optimization_basis.direction: g^T d + .5 d^T(G+M)d with d^T M d<=.25; M=actual U^TU+class-balanced prediction Fisher
optimization_basis.theoretical_scope: Coordinate-aware SPD trust subproblem and complete implicit score derivatives; no query accuracy, forgetting, generalization or spaceborne cost guarantee

resource_rationale.head_resources: Same explicit 100 Newton/64 backtrack/160 MiB owned-factor limits; no head hyperparameter change
resource_rationale.fraction_operations: 65536 guard; direct loop upper bound <=27000 instrumented Fraction calls for a completed 160x5 full-rank construction; no performance selection
resource_rationale.integer_bits: 65536 configured conservative operand/intermediate bit guard; not a proof of success for all ill-conditioned binary64 inputs; failure retained without automatic limit increase
resource_rationale.secular_iterations: 128 fixed bounded solve limit, not candidate search; exhaustion retains failure
resource_rationale.basis_scope: One ordinary immutable dictionary construction per row, separately archived and charged once; every preparation binds same object and measures actual Gram work; no support fitting during construction

artifact_plan.row_basis: <row>/probe/row_basis metadata/certificate/arrays as producer declares; construction once
artifact_plan.independent_analysis: Fresh independent analysis after all four declared rows close
artifact_plan.report: Paired A/B/C, full K x new class count, gain/drop/absGap/H, receiver/model strata and actual measured costs; missing N/A
